articles.summary: AMETEK Scientific Instruments (SI), under the Princeton Applied Research brand, announces the launch of the PARSTAT Multichannel – Advanced Technology (PMC-AT) series of potentiostats, a next-generation platform engineered to transform electrochemical research workflows.
articles.title: AMETEK SI Launches PARSTAT Multichannel – Advanced Technology Series of Potentiostats

articles.summary: Creaform, a business of AMETEK, Inc. and worldwide provider of automated and portable 3D measurement solutions, has launched HandySCAN 3D|EVO Series™, the most powerful handheld 3D laser scanning solution on the market. This innovative series features a built-in touchscreen display and an integrated photo camera, incorporating augmented reality (AR) and advanced on-scanner visualization to significantly enhance the user experience.
articles.title: Creaform Announces New HandySCAN 3D|EVO Series™ Portable 3D Scanner
